faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Here are some of our most frequently asked questions. If you have any other questions, feel free to reach out to us at team@scibly.com.

questions.a: Scibly makes the knowledge inside your experts' heads accessible to the entire company. Existing knowledge automatically becomes up-to-date documentation and courses as well as role-based onboarding programs. Knowledge spreads further and new hires get up to speed faster.

Scibly runs guided interviews with your experts and taps knowledge from sources like Slack, code reviews, tickets and documents. That builds a knowledge base with cited sources, from which courses and role-based onboardings are created. New team members can also ask questions and give feedback right inside the onboarding, so it keeps improving automatically.

Scibly is GDPR compliant and uses only models hosted in the EU. Your data is never used to train AI models nor passed on to third parties, and it is encrypted both in transit and at rest. For maximum control you can also self-host Scibly, because Scibly is open source.

questions.q: How quickly can we get started?
questions.a: Once Scibly is connected to your existing tools like Slack, GitHub or Notion, knowledge extraction starts automatically. From the knowledge gathered, our AI agent additionally creates interactive courses and onboardings within minutes.

Scibly is open core: most of the code is on GitHub under AGPLv3, with only a few enterprise features excluded. You can clone the repository, boot the stack on your own infrastructure and self-host Scibly.
